member.name: T:Softwein.Secure.License
member.summary: Provides a copy protection software license. An Ethernet adapter is required to generate a unique serial number.

member.name: M:Softwein.Secure.License.WriteKey(System.String)
member.summary: Update the license by applying a license key.
member.returns: True if license key was accepted.

member.name: M:Softwein.Secure.License.ReadKey
member.summary: Reads the license key identifying the license instance.
member.returns: A license key or an empty string if license instance not valid.

member.name: M:Softwein.Secure.License.Encode(System.String,System.String,System.DateTime,System.UInt32)
member.summary: Serializes the license content into a fixed length string.

member.name: M:Softwein.Secure.License.GetNetworkAdapterAddress
member.summary: Gets the MAC address of the first Ethernet LAN network adapter uniquely identifying a computer.
member.returns: Network adapter address or null if no adapter found.

member.name: M:Softwein.Secure.License.GetBiosId
member.summary: Gets the serial number of the BIOS.

member.name: M:Softwein.Secure.License.GetBaseBoardId
member.summary: Gets the serial number of the motherboard. Could be identical with the BIOS ID.

member.name: M:Softwein.Secure.License.GetDiskId
member.summary: Gets the volume serial number of the logical system drive. The S/N is generated when the disk is formatted. It can easily be changed. Identical computers might have the same S/N. So it's not really unique.

member.name: P:Softwein.Secure.License.SerialNumber
member.summary: Serial number of the license instance.

member.name: P:Softwein.Secure.License.ExpirationDate
member.summary: Expiration date of the license instance.

member.name: P:Softwein.Secure.License.Dongle
member.summary: Dongle value of the license instance. Empty if no dongle required.

member.name: P:Softwein.Secure.License.Value
member.summary: Generic value of the license instance.

member.name: P:Softwein.Secure.License.IsValid
member.summary: Indicates if the license is valid.
